name: Mark Calaway
caption: The mystery signing ECW teased through June 2007: the giant in black who Chokeslams Raven at Wrestlepalooza and, on the next Blood, Sweat and Beers, Chokeslams him again and drags Vito Thomaselli on top for the pin, then announces Raven against 'The Soul Taker' Mark Calaway for the World Heavyweight Championship at Summer Assylum. On the first televised Bam Bam Exam he tells Bam Bam Bigelow that after Summer Assylum he will be champion, beats Chris Hero on Revolution with the Last Ride after Hero's handshake trick, and teams with Vito against Raven and CM Punk (a Chokeslam on Punk wins while Raven walks out), beats Monsters Inc on Revolution with a Chokeslam on Abyss, and on Blood, Sweat and Beers helps Vito pin Abyss before Raven and Punk shock them both with cattle prods. He beats Vito in the First Blood Match Raven turns into a pinfall match and carries him out, loses to Raven at Summer Assylum when Rhino Gores him, lifts Paul Heyman by the throat to demand Rhino at Heatwave, and in August feuds with Sabu, Rhino and Nate Hatred, Chokeslamming Hatred and then Sabu to win and being Gored by Rhino.

name: Hefner

They offer him photo shoots with the company's women wrestlers (four a year, with all the profits of the magazine sales), mutual advertising and no stock, and promise no change to the product; he asks whether they are proposing 'an extensive partnership', congratulates them on their negotiating and says that he will be in touch.
